hero.philosophy: Committed to a lifetime of learning, discovery and helping others.

profile.title: A laboratory profile shaped by precision, research and continuous learning.
profile.body: I am a Higher Technician in Clinical and Biomedical Laboratory and Technician in Laboratory Operations based in Berlin. My training connects clinical diagnostics, molecular biology, immunology and analytical laboratory work under GLP standards.
profile.pointLanguages: Spanish native · English B2 · German A2

experience.title: From translational immunology to analytical and industrial laboratory work.
experience.body: My practical experience includes immunology and molecular biology research in Madrid and biomass analysis in Ireland, combining clinical samples, analytical protocols and independent laboratory responsibility.
experience.pointResearch: La Princesa University Hospital research foundation · 2025

education.title: Strong academic results with a clinical, analytical and biomedical foundation.
education.body: I graduated with distinction as a Higher Technician in Clinical and Biomedical Laboratory and as a Technician in Laboratory Operations, with final grades of 9.3/10 and 8.69/10.

skills.title: Scientific identity: connecting technical skills, curiosity and translational purpose.

concepts.title: Early-stage scientific ideas shaped by laboratory thinking and translational curiosity.
concepts.body: These concepts are not presented as validated treatments or clinical results. They show how I connect biomedical questions, laboratory methods and responsible research hypotheses.

references.title: Professional and academic references can support the laboratory experience shown here.
references.body: References from academic training, research practice and international laboratory experience can be provided according to the opportunity and recruitment process.

contact.title: Open to laboratory, clinical research and biomedical science opportunities.
contact.body: I am interested in molecular biology, immunology, translational research, scientific outreach and international collaboration in laboratory environments.
